tools.name: api_create
tools.description: Call a POST operation of the ReplyBuddy REST API that has no dedicated tool: it creates records or runs reversible actions. Irreversible operations such as sending messages or broadcasts are refused here and have their own tools. Reference: the ReplyBuddy REST API, https://mcp-dev.replybuddy.io/openapi.json.

body.description: JSON body, as describe_api shows it.

path.description: Operation path with real IDs, without /api/v1, e.g. /deals/3f2a9c1e-0000-0000-0000-000000000000. Under /agents/{id} the connected workspace is used whatever id is passed.

query.description: Query parameters by name, as describe_api lists them.

tools.name: api_read
tools.description: Call a GET operation of the ReplyBuddy REST API that has no dedicated tool. Reference: the ReplyBuddy REST API, https://mcp-dev.replybuddy.io/openapi.json.

path.description: Operation path with real IDs, without /api/v1, e.g. /deals/3f2a9c1e-0000-0000-0000-000000000000. Under /agents/{id} the connected workspace is used whatever id is passed.

query.description: Query parameters by name, as describe_api lists them.

tools.name: create_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Start sending signed event POSTs (incoming messages, handoffs, deals) to a public https URL of the business backend. Returns the signing secret once.

events.description:
Events to deliver: message.received (incoming client messages only),
conversation.handoff_requested, deal.created, deal.moved, deal.updated, deal.deleted.

url.description: URL is a public https URL; it cannot be changed later.

tools.name: describe_api
tools.description: Describe one ReplyBuddy REST API operation: path parameters, query parameters and body as JSON Schema, and the response schema. Pass method and path as search_api returned them. Reference: the ReplyBuddy REST API, https://mcp-dev.replybuddy.io/openapi.json.

tools.name: search_api
tools.description: Search the ReplyBuddy REST API operations this connection may call, by keywords such as "deal fields" or "reorder goals". Returns method, path, summary, whether the call reads or writes, and the dedicated tool when there is one. Reference: the ReplyBuddy REST API, https://mcp-dev.replybuddy.io/openapi.json.
